capabilities: Track consecutive-day streaks and personal records
Record quantities per habit in daily notes
Show progress analytics and charts over 7, 30, or 90 days
Award trophies with confetti at configurable milestones
Switch between Persian and English with Jalali or Gregorian dates
extras: README lists features only; no setup steps, screenshots, or troubleshooting. Habit completion is written into daily notes as Frontmatter properties, so daily notes must be configured.
intentEvidence: HormuzHabit brings the motivating experience of Duolingo's streak tracker to everyday habits inside Obsidian.
motivation: The README says the author wanted to bring "the motivating experience of Duolingo's streak tracker to everyday habits inside Obsidian."
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log daily habit progress, see consecutive-day streaks, or review trends over time.

relations.evidence: HormuzHabit brings the motivating experience of Duolingo's streak tracker to everyday habits inside Obsidian.

summary: Habit tracker that records daily amounts in daily notes, builds streaks, and shows progress charts and trophy milestones.
